'''Aurell''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]] located in the [[Auratera system/Legends|Auratera system]] of the [[Vorzyd sector/Legends|Vorzyd sector]], itself located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The star was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by three [[Planet/Legends|planets]], which included [[Auratera/Legends|Auratera]], and was located along the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]]. Although the Auratera [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained another star, [[Ryern/Legends|Ryern]], all three planets orbited the larger Aurell. Despite that, Ryern helped to illuminate Auratera's [[Atmosphere/Legends|sky]], which meant that [[Local day/Legends|nights]] could occur on the planet only when Aurell completely eclipsed Ryern.<ref name="NoP" />

The distance between the system's two stars varied over [[Time/Legends|time]], which affected Auratera's [[Temperature/Legends|temperature]]. Sometimes, the stars appeared adjacent from the planet's surface, while at other times the stars did not appear together in the sky. When the stars were adjacent, Auratera saw particularly bright and [[Temperature/Legends|hot]] [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. Regardless of their proximity, Aurell was always brighter than Ryern, with the latter never reaching more than a third of the former's brightness.<ref name="NoP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aurell was mentioned in the [[2016]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Nexus of Power]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[roleplaying game]] system.<ref name="NoP" />
